assertions.text: Output has exactly one line per input bullet (6 lines), each in the form `- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)`
Lines are grouped in the order FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE
Input order is kept inside a group (dark mode before csv export; crash before wrong total)
feature maps to FEAT, bug to FIX, docs to DOCS, and refactor (anything else) to CHORE
Each summary is sentence case with no trailing period and at most 60 characters
